card.name: Linking words before neuropathy types
card.fires_on: Small linking words (is, by, were, with, an) or partway through a long term, right before a specific type of peripheral neuropathy or polyneuropathy is named in a list of nerve-related adverse effects.

modes.label: Linking verb before the type
modes.description: Verb or preposition after a phrase like 'most common peripheral neuropathies' that leads into the named type.

modes.label: Inside neuropathy terms
modes.description: Partway through long nerve-disease words such as axonal or demyelinating polyneuropathy.

card.writes: The promoted tokens mean 'handling' or 'processing', which has no clear link to the text, so no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the little words just before the text says which kind of nerve damage occurred.
